raw_facts.label: TwinTech® NoFrost: Dual cooling keeps humidity in the fridge to prevent food from drying out, while the freezer stays frost-free.
Extra cool: The temperature drops for a set time to quickly chill large amounts of food, then returns to normal—ideal for parties or BBQs.
DynamicAir: The fan ensures efficient circulation of cold air in the refrigerator.
Sliding fittings: Attach a matching cupboard door, using sliding rails and cabinet-hinges.
Control type: Electronic temperature control with touch control and LCD screen.
Designed and manufactured in Europe by AEG.
